statement: CXMT's Shanghai IPO raised $8.6 billion, funding further memory capacity expansion by the world's fourth-largest DRAM maker.
why: Fresh capital of this size is what turns a small-batch HBM line into meaningful bit supply a few years out.

impact.mechanism: IPO proceeds fund memory capex, which eventually adds DRAM and HBM bits to a market where supply is the binding constraint on accelerator output.

evidence.excerpt: CXMT's IPO in Shanghai raised $8.6 billion

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet reporting company financial context; the article does not state how proceeds are allocated, so the capacity link is inference.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: Investing.com, Investing.com (citing Herald Economy)
